caption: find your rank. send it to the one who's #1. two eclipses, one mercury retrograde, all in february.

slides.headline: cancer, you get the quiet month. use it.
slides.body: no eclipse, no station, no planet moving into your sign. a good month to rest and let other people do the drama.

slides.headline: libra, the sky gives you a breather.
slides.body: the big moves land elsewhere. notice who checks in when nothing is happening. that's the person.

slides.headline: scorpio, you watch from the side and take notes.
slides.body: the feb 6 eclipse lands in aquarius, square to your sign, so you feel it at an angle. listen more than you test.

slides.headline: taurus, valentine's morning starts in your sign.
slides.body: the first quarter moon is in taurus on feb 14. astrologers read it as a small push. if you want something, say it early.

slides.headline: aries, the slow planets in your sign get poked.
slides.body: saturn and neptune sit in aries. venus squares neptune on feb 5 and saturn on feb 13. read it as love asking for patience and clear words. you can do both.

slides.headline: sagittarius, venus leaves you on feb 3.
slides.body: your flirt season is over. the last quarter moon lands in sagittarius on feb 28: close the tab on one maybe.

slides.headline: gemini, uranus starts moving forward again.
slides.body: uranus turns direct in gemini on feb 8 after months of apparent backward drift. read it as the restless part of you finally getting a direction.

slides.headline: capricorn, venus is in your sign all month.
slides.body: venus enters capricorn on feb 3 and stays past valentine's. astrologers read it as your charm season. let people see you want something.

slides.headline: pisces, mercury turns backwards in your sign.
slides.body: mercury stations retrograde in pisces on feb 9 and the sun enters pisces on feb 18. your season starts with a re-read. send the text you drafted twice.

slides.headline: leo, mars comes back to you, backwards.
slides.body: jupiter is retrograde in leo, and on feb 21 mars backs in too. read it as old pride up for review, not a fight to win.

slides.headline: virgo, an eclipse in your sign, then mars leaves.
slides.body: a penumbral lunar eclipse falls in virgo on feb 20. a day later retrograde mars backs out of virgo into leo. read it as a quiet ending and a lighter load.

slides.headline: aquarius, the eclipse is in your sign.
slides.body: an annular solar eclipse lands in your sign on feb 6, with pluto there too. astrologers read it as a real reset. pick one thing.
